text:
There are no Escherichia coli records in the available pathogen data network databases, only viral pathogens and influenza lineages data sets are included in the indexed organisms databases. The influenza data is available but it is in "GenSpectrum Loculus" database under influenza related organisms (e.g., influenza-a, h1n1pdm, influenza-b), while E. coli is not part of these networks.

Therefore, influenza data is not part of the E. coli records in these databases. If you want, I can check influenza data separately or search for data related to either influenza or E. coli individually. Would you like me to proceed in any of these ways?
